properties.source: Hand-traced simplified axis, checked against streamlines of the NOAA AOML Global Drifter Program annual-mean near-surface velocity climatology (Laurindo, Mariano & Lumpkin 2017; public domain). South-west from off the Strait of Gibraltar along the Moroccan coast about 200 km offshore, through the Canary Islands (between Fuerteventura and Gran Canaria), south along the Saharan coast to Cape Blanc (about 21 N), then west into the North Equatorial Current north of Cape Verde. The drifter mean also shows much of the flow peeling off west at 25-30 N. Eastern boundary currents are broad (several hundred km) and slow in the mean, so the single line is schematic.
refs: NOAA AOML GDP drifter annual-mean climatology (Laurindo, Mariano & Lumpkin 2017, doi:10.1016/j.dsr.2017.04.009; dataset doi:10.7266/N7SJ1HN5; accessed 2026-10-12)
